subject: Proof points & smoke-validation plan for MAP — next steps
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@medsync.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proof points & smoke-validation plan for MAP — next steps

Samantha —

Thanks again for a productive demo last week. As discussed, I attached a working MAP draft (RDW-MAP-draft-20270809.xlsx) that lays out:

- Success hypothesis (what "good" looks like)
- Exit gates and go/no-go signals
- Minimum viable acceptance tests (smoke + regression) with owners and timeboxes
- Close timeline and sign-off milestones

Topline proposal: 6-week evaluation with two phased checkpoints — a smoke-validation week (week 1) to confirm integration and latency baselines, then a 4-week feature/accuracy run with continuous quality checks, and a final sign-off week for handoff and operational readiness.

Key acceptance criteria (summary):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation < 700ms for common paths (<= 1,024 tokens)
2) Throughput: Sustained 1.8K requests/hr during peak simulated load with <2% tail errors
3) Quality: Top-line F1 on labeled prompt set >= 0.78 and no more than 4 regressions vs baseline prompts
4) Safety/compliance: PII redaction passes 95% precision on sample 2000-record set
5) Integration: Prefix caching and auth flows completed end-to-end; no persistent 5xxs for 72 hours

Smoke tests (week 1) are attached as smoke-test-cases.pdf. They’re lightweight and intended to validate connectivity, latency envelope, and basic response correctness. We recommend the following owners:
- MedSync engineering: integration hooks and traffic shaping (Mike)
- Redwood PoC engineer: runtime config and quantization profile (PrIyom)
- Midpoint QA: run labeled prompt set and record scoring (Lauren)

Questions before I circulate this as the mutual action plan:
- Anything missing from your side that would be a hard blocker for the smoke week?
- Any constraints on test data we should be aware of (e.g., PHI/PII handling)?

Next step: If this looks good, I’ll convert the spreadsheet into a shared timeline in Drive and schedule a 30-minute sync to lock owners.

Thanks,

Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: RDW-MAP-draft-20270809.xlsx (workbook)
Attachment: smoke-test-cases.pdf (test plan)

From: Samantha Cole <samantha@medsync.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Rivera <mike.rivera@medsync.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof points & smoke-validation plan for MAP — next steps

Nikhil —

Appreciate the clear draft. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock the timeline:

1) Smoke week scope — can we confirm that smoke will only run on our staging environment (not prod)? We want to avoid any perf artifacts leaking to the live system.
2) Data constraints — we have a subset of de-identified records for QA; we can share a 2k-row CSV but it can’t include raw PHI. Will that be sufficient for the PII redaction checks?
3) SLAs — we’re sensitive to tail latency; if 95th is at 700ms can you share what the 99th looks like in your hosted profile for similar customers?

If those look ok, I can commit to the proposed owners on our end (Mike for infra, myself for product acceptance). Also, is there a place to add our compliance evidence (SOC2 summary) to the MAP? Mike, loop in if you have questions.

—Sam
Samantha Cole
VP Product | MedSync
samantha@medsync.com

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@medsync.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proof points & smoke-validation plan for MAP — next steps

Thanks Sam — great questions. Quick answers:

1) Smoke week will run exclusively in your staging environment. We’ll provide a short-lived staging token and a preconfigured runtime image to avoid any dependency on your prod stack.
2) De-identified 2k CSV is perfect for the PII/redaction pass. We’ll run the redaction checks and return a short report (precision/recall) within 48 hours of receipt.
3) 99th percentile: for comparable workloads we typically see 99th at ~1.8s on a single-region hosted profile without batching; with our suggested batching/kv-cache config for this workload, we expect 99th near ~1.1–1.3s. We’ll run a short baseline during smoke to confirm.

Proposed minor addition to the MAP (I’ll update the spreadsheet): add a "Non-blocker watchlist" of known risk items (legitmate false positives on redaction, slow cold-start for long-context prompts, and tokenization edge cases). Those will have clear actions and owners but do not block pass if addressed with documented mitigations.

Also attaching a minimal KPI table (kpi-table-v1.csv) which maps each acceptance signal to measurement method and owner.

If that works, Nikhil — please schedule the 30-min sync and I’ll bring our PoC engineer.

Cheers,
PrIyom Das
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

Attachment: kpi-table-v1.csv (metrics mapping)

Thanks everyone — this is great progress. Quick summary and agreed next steps I’ll action today: 

1) Smoke week scope: staging only (Redwood to provide staging token and runtime image) — owner: Mike (MedSync), PrIyom (Redwood)
2) Data: MedSync provides de-identified 2k CSV by Tue EOD — owner: Mike
3) SOC2/network diagram: Redwood to upload SOC2 summary + staging network diagram to shared Drive folder by Thu EOD — owner: Nikhil (I’ll coordinate with Security).
4) KPI mapping and measurement: PrIyom to run baseline during smoke and produce the 95th/99th latency table + quality report within 48 hours of smoke run completion — owner: PrIyom
5) Acceptance gates: defined in workbook. Final sign-off meeting tentatively scheduled for week of Sep 13 — Nikhil to send calendar invite after we lock timelines.

I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet with the security evidence task and the non-blocker watchlist PrIyom mentioned. If everyone is aligned I’ll convert the sheet to a timeline and share the Drive link + 30-min kickoff invite for tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to this.
